notes.title: Leaderboard Challenge
notes.content:
[h1]Participate in the Leaderboard Challenge ![/h1]

[h3]Play the level 2 of the demo and reach one of the TOP 3 position to win a steam key at the release.[/h3]

You have till end of May (May 31st, 2024) to complete the challenge.

The 3 best players on top of the leaderboard (world leaderboard of couse, not friend leaderboard 😉) will receive a steam key for the full game release.

NB: keys will be distributed before the release.
NB: cheating score detected will be deleted and not considered.
